verdict.rationale: Supabase serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured 'API and agent resources' section pointing to OpenAPI spec, MCP server, and per-language llms/*.txt corpora plus llms-full.txt, and also exposes a machine-discoverable agent-skills index at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json — both directly confirmed by hands-on probes. missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration that agents actually consume llms.txt successfully in practice, and /docs.md returns 404 so not every doc surface has a machine-readable twin.
